title: Kamishiro Rui — Carefree Prodigy〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh dear, over here too?
I almost missed that one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
What's Rui doing at the flowerbed...gasp!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is he already making preparations for another frightful piece of stage direction that he recently dreamed up?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui!
What crazy scheme are you up to this time?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What is it? Why the terrified look?
I'm just pulling weeds, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: S-Say what? So, you're trying to do something with weeds?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not doing anything with them.
The poor flowers won't get any sun if I don't pull out the weeds, that's all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the?! The person who tries to light me on fire or blast me into orbit is feeling sorry for flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't possibly be so humane!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's a lot of ruckus about me just pulling weeds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Aha! A fever!
You must be having an incredibly high fever, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not. I'm only doing what's expected of me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ex-Expected?! You being nice to flowers is expected?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm in the greening committee, you know.
Wouldn't you expect the greening committee to care for flowers?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Would you expect someone who uses class time to make strange robots to take his committee duties so seriously?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: In fact, it'd make more sense if you'd used one of your strange machines to do the job for you, right?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would probably be more efficient. However, you need some delicacy and finesse for this, or you may end up hurting the flowers instead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're worried about hurting the flowers?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't you ever get tired of overreacting?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not acting surprised for fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I still can't believe you're just trying to do committee work. You must be plotting something devious...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Sigh...
Ah, by the way, Tsukasa, you're afraid of bugs, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Eek! Wh-What do you mean?
There's nothing in this world I'm afraid of—

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: GYAAAH!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just a caterpillar, you don't have to be so... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urk!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wow. That was quite a neat tumble.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: ... *twitch*

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sorry I had knock you off your feet like that. You really should be watching where you go. You almost stepped on that flower, you know.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now then... I guess you must have fallen out when they were sowing the seeds. Don't grow here all by yourself. Come here instead.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This should be a good place.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh. I was wondering why the sudden attack...
You did it for that flower, huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't possibly watch you stamp on the flower before my very eyes now, can I?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... I had no idea you were such a big lover of flowers. I apologize for not believing you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm not bothered by that.
And I wouldn't call myself a lover of flowers, really. More like...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahh?! Look at what you've done to my uniform!
I need to clean off all this mud quickly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh... There he goes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like Tsukasa hasn't realized just how wonderful all of you are, yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How you're able to bring a smile to someone's face by just blooming beautifully right there.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, that's the end of my work on your stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't stop performing your lovely shows for us here.
